text.en:
of Presidential Decree No. 356, entitled "CREATING THE PROVINCE OF BASILAN," to read as
"Sec. 4. The present elective officials of the Province of Zamboanga del Sur shall perform their duties as such
officials in the newly created Province of Basilan until the officials of the latter shall have been duly
appointed by the President: Provided, That the elective officials of the new province of Basilan shall consist of
one provincial governor, three vice-governors and six board members. Such officials thus appointed shall hold
office until their successors shall have been elected in the election for provincial and municipal officials
following the issuance of this Decree and shall have qualified unless sooner removed at the pleasure of the
President. Other appointive officials and employees as may be necessary to organize or to complete the
government personnel of the province herein created shall be appointed as provided by law."
This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 1st day of March, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-four.
